problem_text:
A logistics company needs to coordinate 8 delivery trucks through 8 specialized loading bays.

Each truck must follow a specific loading sequence represented as (Bay, Duration) pairs,
where each pair indicates the required loading bay and the time needed to complete that loading step.
The order of pairs defines the strict sequence in which loading operations must be performed.

Truck details:
* T1 requires the sequence: (Bay7, 6) → (Bay2, 5) → (Bay5, 2) → (Bay4, 1) → (Bay3, 7) → (Bay1, 5) → (Bay6, 6) → (Bay8, 10)
* T2 requires the sequence: (Bay4, 8) → (Bay3, 3) → (Bay8, 6) → (Bay2, 7) → (Bay1, 7) → (Bay6, 7) → (Bay5, 6) → (Bay7, 10)
* T3 requires the sequence: (Bay2, 8) → (Bay1, 4) → (Bay5, 7) → (Bay4, 2) → (Bay8, 7) → (Bay7, 1) → (Bay3, 5) → (Bay6, 10)
* T4 requires the sequence: (Bay3, 3) → (Bay8, 1) → (Bay7, 2) → (Bay5, 6) → (Bay1, 6) → (Bay6, 8) → (Bay2, 4) → (Bay4, 4)
* T5 requires the sequence: (Bay6, 7) → (Bay8, 1) → (Bay5, 2) → (Bay4, 1) → (Bay3, 2) → (Bay7, 6) → (Bay1, 4) → (Bay2, 5)
* T6 requires the sequence: (Bay2, 4) → (Bay5, 2) → (Bay3, 3) → (Bay1, 8) → (Bay7, 3) → (Bay6, 3) → (Bay8, 8) → (Bay4, 5)
* T7 requires the sequence: (Bay3, 2) → (Bay4, 2) → (Bay6, 5) → (Bay5, 2) → (Bay1, 7) → (Bay8, 4) → (Bay2, 5) → (Bay7, 7)
* T8 requires the sequence: (Bay4, 10) → (Bay8, 7) → (Bay6, 10) → (Bay5, 4) → (Bay3, 5) → (Bay1, 6) → (Bay2, 9) → (Bay7, 6)

Each loading operation must run continuously once it begins and cannot be interrupted,
and each loading bay can only accommodate one truck at a time.
The objective is to determine the processing schedule for all loading operations across the bays
so that the total completion time for all trucks is minimized.
